title: Retirement orchestration for legacy config endpoints and tenant migration checklist
creator: Aisha Kwan
description: Scope: retire the legacy /v1/config and /v1/tenant-config endpoints that are used by older SDK versions and some Dedicated/Private customers. This ticket covers: audit of tenants using legacy endpoints, generation of tenant-specific migration guides, SDK deprecation warnings, proxy redirect window, telemetry and alerting for migration progress, CS outreach playbook, in-product banners, and final removal scheduling. Goal: decommission endpoints with clear migration path and minimal outage risk for high-value customers.
acceptance_criteria: All tenants currently calling /v1/config or /v1/tenant-config are identified and a migration owner is assigned for each tenant.
Migration guides published (Docs + per-tenant delta notes) and referenced by SDK warning messages.
SDKs (python, js) emit deprecation warnings v3.4+ with links to guides and automated opt-in redirect for customers who consent.
Proxy-level 30-day redirect implemented that forwards calls to the compatibility shim with trace headers for telemetry.
Monitoring dashboards show migration progress per-tenant and raise automatic escalations if non-migrated high-traffic tenants remain after 45 days.
Customer Success (CS) outreach completed for high-impact tenants and tickets logged for migration blockers.
Final removal checklist complete and scheduled after legal/comms sign-off and a minimum 60-day notice window.

comms_plan: Tiered outreach: automated email to all affected tenants, targeted CS-managed calls for top 25 tenants.
In-product banner with link to migration guide and one-click opt-in redirect for a 30-day extension.
Public blog post summarizing rationale and timeline on day 1 of notice window.
Release notes entry with migration snippets and SDK version table; include opt-in SDK flag documentation.
migration_steps: Run compatibility scanner to list resources referencing legacy endpoints.
Apply SDK patch or update client to use /v2/config endpoints and update auth header where applicable.
Verify tenant traffic on staging using trace headers and run smoke tests for KV cache behavior.
Schedule cutover in low-traffic window; CS to attend for high-impact tenants.
Confirm telemetry no longer reports legacy endpoint calls for tenant and file completion report.
monitoring_signals: Per-tenant p95 latency increase >10% after redirect => rollback and investigate.
Daily remaining legacy calls per-tenant; alert if >5% of baseline for 7 consecutive days after soft-redirect.
High error-rate spike (>1% 5xx) after soft-redirect triggers automated revert for that tenant and creates incident ticket.
risk_mitigation: Maintain compatibility shim for 60 days after soft-redirect to allow hot-fixes.
Provide one-click rollback for any tenant experiencing latency or error regressions.
CS and on-call ENG rota scheduled during both soft-redirect and hard-block windows.
Legal/comms sign-off gating final removal; extend windows for enterprise tenants with contract requirements.
